cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says a court case management system is in service in any court. The Cotonou commercial court has taken some filings online since February 2026.
cells.note: An e-justice information system for criminal and civil procedures was at feasibility study in 2024 (BEN-001), so it is under way. Online filing at the Cotonou commercial court (BEN-004) cannot count while no case management system is shown in service.
